title: Cheddar Cheese Scones
summary: Classic British scones packed with sharp cheddar and a tender, crumbly crumb. Best served warm as a savoury snack with butter or chutney.
steps: Heat the oven to 220°C and line a baking tray with baking paper.
In a large bowl, mix the plain flour, baking powder and salt.
Add the cold butter and rub it in with your fingertips until the mixture looks like coarse breadcrumbs.
Stir in the grated cheddar, then pour in most of the milk and mix gently to make a soft dough. Add a little more milk if needed, but do not overwork it.
Tip the dough onto a lightly floured surface and pat it out to about 2 cm thick.
Cut out 8 rounds with a cutter or shape into squares, then place them on the tray so they are just touching for softer sides.
Brush the tops with a little milk and bake for 12 to 15 minutes, until risen and golden brown.
Cool for a few minutes before serving warm.
